-- =================================================================
-- Description:	This gets a basic report for [Suscripcion] table
-- =================================================================
CREATE PROCEDURE [dbo].[rpt_Suscripcion_Index]
@EntityId AS INT = 0, 
@Membresia_Id AS INT = 0, 
@Suscriptor_Id AS INT = 0, 
@TipoSuscripcion_Id AS INT = 0
AS
BEGIN
	
	-- IMPORTANT:
	-- This is a computer generated procedure.  DO NOT ADD CUSTOM CODE TO THIS PROCEDURE.

	-- SET NOCOUNT ON added to prevent extra result sets from
	-- interfering with SELECT statements.
	SET NOCOUNT ON;
	
	-- 1) CREATE FILTER TABLE:
	DECLARE @SuscripcionFilter TABLE (
		Id INT IDENTITY (1,1),
		Suscripcion_Id INT		
	)


    -- IF A GIVEN ID HAS BEEN SPECIFIED, THEN RETRIEVE THAT RECORD ONLY
	IF @EntityId <> 0
	BEGIN

		INSERT INTO @SuscripcionFilter (Suscripcion_Id)
		SELECT 
			[Suscripcion].Id
		FROM [dbo].[Suscripcion]
		WHERE
			 [dbo].[Suscripcion].[Id] = @EntityId

	END
	ELSE
	BEGIN

		-- 2) FILTER BY FOREIGN RELATIONSHIPS WHEN APLICABLE:
		INSERT INTO @SuscripcionFilter (Suscripcion_Id)
		SELECT 
			[Suscripcion].Id
		FROM [dbo].[Suscripcion]
		WHERE
			 [Suscripcion].[Activo] = 1 AND
         (([Suscripcion].[Membresia_Id] = @Membresia_Id) OR (@Membresia_Id = 0)) AND
         (([Suscripcion].[Suscriptor_Id] = @Suscriptor_Id) OR (@Suscriptor_Id = 0)) AND
         (([Suscripcion].[TipoSuscripcion_Id] = @TipoSuscripcion_Id) OR (@TipoSuscripcion_Id = 0))

 	END

 
	-- 4) DELIVER THE FILTERED RESULTS:
	SELECT 
		[Suscripcion].[Id],
		[Suscriptor].[Nombre]  + ' ' + [Suscriptor].[ApellidoPaterno] + ' ' + [Suscriptor].[ApellidoMaterno] as Nombre,
		[Suscriptor].[CorreoElectronico] AS [CorreoElectronico],	
		[Membresia].[ClaveMembresia] AS [ClaveMembresia],
		[Membresia].[Id] AS [Membresia_Id],
		[InformacionFacturacion].[RazonSocial],
		[InformacionFacturacion].[RFC],
		[Suscripcion].[NumeroTarjetaAcceso],		
		[Suscripcion].[Suscriptor_Id],
		[TipoSuscripcion].[Nombre] AS [TipoSuscripcionNombre],
		[Suscripcion].[FechaCreacion],
		[Suscripcion].[CreadoPor],
		[Suscripcion].[FechaModificacion],
		[Suscripcion].[ModificadoPor],
		[EstatusMembresia].[Nombre] AS [EstatusMembresia]
	FROM @SuscripcionFilter filter
		JOIN [dbo].[Suscripcion] 
			ON [Suscripcion].[Id] = filter.[Suscripcion_Id] 			

		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Membresia]
		ON [dbo].[Suscripcion].[Membresia_Id] = [dbo].[Membresia].[Id] 

 		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[Suscriptor]
		ON [dbo].[Suscripcion].[Suscriptor_Id] = [dbo].[Suscriptor].[Id] 

 		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[TipoSuscripcion]
		ON [dbo].[Suscripcion].[TipoSuscripcion_Id] = [dbo].[TipoSuscripcion].[Id] 

		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[EstatusMembresia]
		ON [dbo].[Membresia].[EstatusMembresia_Id] = [dbo].[EstatusMembresia].[Id] 

		LEFT JOIN [dbo].[InformacionFacturacion]
		ON [dbo].[Membresia].[InformacionFacturacion_Id] = [dbo].[InformacionFacturacion].[Id] 

 
END

Name: rpt_Suscripcion_Index
